language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: This bus stop is packed with pedestrians, waiting for the next bus. What they don't know is... next stop... SLAMVILLE!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_02_OL_DESCRIPTION: Outscore your opponents by wrecking yourself from the top of the quarry.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: Time to have some vicious fun from the top of the crane. Impress the reaper by staying alive.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_03_OL_DESCRIPTION: Outscore your opponents by wrecking yourself from the top of the factory.

language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_04_DESCRIPTION: How long of a bail can you manage from this rocky outcropping? Make it look good for the video. Tips:^- Plan your bail^- Do push-offs while bailing^- Use the terrain to extend your bail
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_04_OL_DESCRIPTION: What a view! Use it to your advantage and wreck yourself!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_05_OL_DESCRIPTION: There are lots of things to smash yourself on below. Enjoy the pain!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_06_DESCRIPTION: Some workers have set up shop on top of the rooftops. Use the spillway to take them by surprise and wreck their setup.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_06_TIP_01: Get speed! Extend your bail with push-offs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_07_DESCRIPTION: Safety doesn't come first here. See the sharp ledges and rocks jutting out from the wall? Hit them to rack up your bail score.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_INDU_08_DESCRIPTION: Drop into the boat to get some huge air and crash through the broken roof.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_00_DESC: Mmmm... Meat Battle. Compete for Hall of Meat points from the top of the Library.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_01_DESC: Toss your meat off the balcony here and cannonball down the stairs.^Tip: Push-off when your feet hit the ground.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_01_OL_DESC: Get the highest Hall of Meat score off the pavilion.

language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_02_DESC: Bail off the Clock Tower for massive campus meat!

language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_02_OL_DESC: Get the highest Hall of Meat score from the top of the Clock Tower
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_03_DESC: Rack up Hall of Meat points with the sickest bails you can within the time limit.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_03_OL_DESC: Cause you're digging yourself a grave! Show off your best bails in the University Ditch
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_04_DESC: Learn the basics of bailing from the top of the Library. Falling on your face never felt better!

language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_04_OBJ9_HINT_1: Heavy impact and tweaked style earn more Hall of Meat Points!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_04_OL_DESC: Drop an epic bail from the top of the stadium, or use the speed to bail the distance. Pick your style, pick your pain!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_05_DESC: Studying can take a lot out of you. Hurling yourself off the Library might take a little more...
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_05_OBJ0: Bail from the Library to the Target
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_05_OL_DESC: Compete for meat in the Super-Ultra Mega-Park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_06_DESC: Time to knock this one outta the park! Hospital fees aside, this is going to be one epic bail!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_06_OBJ1: Bail Across and land on Emblem
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_07_DESC: Rack up some serious Hall of Meat points off the University Ditch bridge.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_HOM_UNIV_08_DESC: Use your pushoffs and body tweaks to hit the rocky ledges and keep your bail going all the way down.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_JAM_FIRST_DESCRIPTION: Compete against other skaters to get the most points in the alloted time. Multiple rounds may be required to pick a survivor!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_MONSTER_DESC: A monster sized big air contest in Hartley Stadium. Win and the stadium is all yours for «Park!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_MOVEABLE_OBJECT_TIP: Use the left stick to move the Dumpster and the right stick to rotate it
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_ACCU_01_DESC: One, two, three, four. Get your board up off the floor. Tear up this challenge by getting points off the step up or down the stairs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_DESC: You up for the Challenge? Take charge and own the Black Box Skatepark
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_GAP_01_DESC: Grind the hubba and rainbow rail in the center and invert the walls to keep the flow.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_GAP_02_DESC: Some complicated tech required here. Grind the rail, land in manual and gap the stairs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_GAP_02_OBJ0_HINT: You gotta make it all in one sequence!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_GAP_03_DESC: Some killer air to be caught in this park if you know where the lines are to get it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_GAP_04_DESC: Slay this outside edge line around the Black Box Skatepark.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_SIMUL_01_DESC: The Box is a perfect manny pad. Show your manual skills on it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_SIMUL_01_OBJ0: Manual or Grind Across the Pad
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_SIMUL_01_OBJ1: Nose-Manual to Nollie-Flip Off the Pad
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_SURV_01_DESC: Trick for points in this section of the Black Box Skatepark without stopping, bailing or leaving the area
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_TAG_01_DESC: Like a mad bull you'll need to start seeing red as you hit all the rails in the Black Box Skatepark.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_TRICK_01_DESC: Hit all the tricks on the list in the Black Box Skatepark.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_TRICK_01_OBJ3: Gap Up the Small Stair Set
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_BBX_01_TRICK_01_OBJ6: Gap Up the Large Stair Set
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWNT_02_GAP_03_DESC: Make your way to the bottom of the Rippon Towers, clearing each of the 3 Stairsets. Keep your multiplier going to score enough points on each.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_ACCU_01_DESC: Kick back, flip some tricks and have some fun. The entire Park 'N Play rooftop is yours to dominate!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_DESC: San Van had a killer parkade, but the Port Carverton Park 'n Play makes us glad we left home. Sick gaps, smooth lines and plenty of rails to play with.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_GAP_01_DESC: Gap the three parkade stair sets with flavor. You've gotta make it tight and do it all in one line.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_GAP_02_DESC: There are a couple of nice gaps after this drop-in. Keep your multiplier going and hit 'em with style.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_GAP_03_DESC: Another sick Park 'N Play line, just don't miss the edge at the end... we left the Hospital back in San Van!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_GAP_04_DESC: Score big on these two huge gaps on your way out of the Park "N Play.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_SIMUL_01_DESC: This is a killer shot from the bottom if you can grind this narrow path.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_SIMUL_02_DESC: This wavy ledge would make an excellent shot. Flip it up and grind it out!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_SURV_01_DESC: Reach the target score on the Park 'N Play sub-roof without stopping, bailing or going offboard.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_TAG_01_DESC: Grind or Gap the back-side of each lamppost along the roof of the Park 'N Play.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_TRICK_01_DESC: Hit all the tricks on this Park 'N Play funbox platform.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_TRICK_02_DESC: Hit all the tricks in the list on the Park 'n Play roof.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_TRICK_02_OBJ11: Do a Board or Lip Slide
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_01_TRICK_02_OBJ4: Gap to Grind the Access Ramp Ledge
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_ACCU_01_DESC: Trick for points in the lower tier of Rippon Towers.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_ACCU_02_DESC: Grind for points down these side-street ledges in the Rippon Towers.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_DESC: High rises, ledges and ribbon-filled plazas. That's right. Ribbons. Yeah, snicker all you want, but once you catch some air off one, you'll be skating them all day.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_GAP_01_DESC: This spot has a couple pretty tech grind gaps. Grind the first high ledge then gap to grind on the second. Next, grind the lower ledge then drop to grind the curved planter.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_GAP_01_OBJ0_HIN: Hitting high grinds is easier in Front Side
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_GAP_02_DESC: See if you can master the three spots between the plaza. Gap out from the high ledge, grind around the waterbed then show your style as you break into the central plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_SIMUL_02_DESC: Pick a ledge and grind down and out of the alley.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_SIMUL_03_DESC: Get some speed and ollie high over the rail to make this grass gap to the Residential Plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_SUMUL_01_DESC: Make your mark on the Rippon Towers archway. Grind it out and that's one more claim to this lot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_SUMUL_01_OBJ1: Grind the Arch and Fliptrick Out
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_SURV_01_DESC: Reach the target point limit at the top of the Residential Plaza without stopping, bailing or going offboard.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_TAG_01_DESC: Hit all the spots in the Rippon Tower ribbon plaza in the time limit.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_TRICK_01_DESC: Complete all the tricks on the list in the Rippon Ribbon Plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_TRICK_01_OBJ4: Transfer to Wall-Ride the Right Ribbon
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_02_TRICK_01_OBJ7: Grind the Top of the Back Wall Ribbon
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_ACCU_01_DESC: Trick for Points around this War Monument.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_DESC: A moment of silence for the Mad Carver, then a lifetime of skating to honor him. Carve out your own legacy and own the Carverton Memorial Park!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_01_DESC: Here's a killer memorial entrance grind line. Keep up your speed to succeed.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_01_OBJ2: Gap and Grind from Plaque to Planter
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_02_DESC: This is a pretty sick line. Hit the two stair gaps, then finish with a couple grinds through the archways.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_03_DESC: Ollie over the rail into the rolling bank and take that speed off the stone to grind-gap over the stairs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_03_OBJ0: Gap the Rail into the Rolling Bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_04_DESC: A scenic straightaway through the Memorial Park, hit the 3 objectives along the way.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_GAP_04_OBJ3: Manual or Grind Off the Final Ledge
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_OBJ1_HINT: Method:^Backside Grab with <B:R_Trigger_hud> then^<B:Stick_Right_R_hud> to tweak.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_OBJ1_HINT2: Method:^Backside Grab with <B:L_Trigger_hud> then^<B:Stick_Right_L_hud> to tweak.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_SIMUL_01_DESC: Drop into this epic bank and gap through the archways across the plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_SURV_01_DESC: Trick for Points around the memorial walls area without stopping, bailing or going offboard
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TAG_01_DESC: Grind all the stones in this section of the Memorial Park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TAG_02_DESC: Grind all 5 memorial walls in the plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TAG_03_DESC: Manual your way down the snaking path, then grind out over the stairset to finish.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TAG_03_OBJ1: Manual to Grind the Stair Ledge
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TRICK_01_DESC: Hit all 10 tricks to complete the Memorial Park Trick List.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TRICK_01_OBJ11: Air into the Arms of the Soldier
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_DWTN_03_TRICK_01_OBJ8_H: Tailgrab:^Push <B:Stick_Right_Up_hud> then press <B:L_Trigger_hud> to Frontside Grab
Tailgrab:^Push <B:Stick_Right_Up_hud> then press <B:R_Trigger_hud> to Frontside Grab
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_ACCU_01_DESCRIP: Rack up points in the spillway. If you make it to the end in time, you can play around in the bowl.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_ACCU_02_DESCRIP: Score big in the spillway bowl.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_DESCRIPTION: The New Factory is a skating longshoreman's dream. From spillway to rooftops, everything is fair game.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_GAP_01_DESCRIPT: You'll have no chance at this unless you carry all your speed to cross the roof gap.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_GAP_02_DESCRIPT: See if you can manual the whole course, between the support beams faster than anyone else.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_GAP_02_OBJ_01: Manual between all the support beams
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_GAP_03_DESCRIPT: There is a massive transfer waiting for you in this pipe. It'll be full speed and squirrelly... then Bang - gap the opening in the pipe!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_LIST_01_DESCRIP: Time to hit up the ghetto spot with everything you've got.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_LIST_01_HINT_10: Get a score multiplier to help with the points
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_LIST_01_OBJ_01: Grind the fence on the bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_LIST_01_OBJ_09: Manny Flip Manny on the slate
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_SIMUL_01_DESCRI: There are 4 rails to hit. Get grinding!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_SURV_01_DESCRIP: Time to live dangerously on the factory roof. The name of the game is consistency no bailing or stopping, and keep scoring.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_TAG_01_DESCRIPT: Make your way around the spillway bowl and make all the transfers.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_TAG_02_DESCRIPT: Grind all the Loading Bay ledges before anyone else does.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_TAG_03_DESCRIPT: Lots of cement, lots of edges. You know what to do.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_01_TAG_04_DESCRIPT: This is 3 minutes of your life you'll never get back. Follow the path and grind all the stair rails on the way down.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_ACCU_01_DESCRIP: The path is long and rocky but there are plenty of points to be had. Survive and you'll destroy it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: Port Carverton owes it's existence to The Quarry. It's the blue collar soul of the city. It's also one of the gnarliest, stoniest skate spots ever.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_GAP_01_DESCRIPT: Transfer between each of the silo dishes then make one last transfer into the truck.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_GAP_02_DESCRIPT: Can you make the gap into the conveyor?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_GAP_03_DESCRIPT: Nail this sick line by dropping off the roof, clearing a couple gaps, and tricking off the wall.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_GAP_03_OBJ_01: Drop off the roof into the bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_GAP_04_DESCRIPT: Pick up speed through the deteriorated building, and use it to launch to the flatbed and then over the dumpster.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_LIST_01_DESCRIP: A list of tricks on some of the nastiest terrain in Port Carverton. Land or slam but lands tend to win.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_LIST_01_OBJ9: Tweak two grabs on any transfer
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_SIMUL_01_DESCRI: Drop some skills on the stairs or the bank.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_SIMUL_01_OBJ: 250 pts on the stairs or bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_SURV_01_DESCRIP: Time to live dangerously on the factory roof. The name of the game is consistency no bailing or stopping, and keep scoring.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_SURV_01_TITLE: The Roof Is On Fire II
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_TAG_01_DESCRIPT: Join the Barrier Kult. Hit up all the barriers as fast as you can.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_TAG_02_DESCRIPT: Unreal how these quarry stones are perfectly laid out. It's like it's a video game or something.^^Serve all tricks on the rocks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_TAG_03_DESCRIPT: Lots of these rails are broken, but whatevs, right? See who can grind 'em all first.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_02_TAG_04_DESCRIPT: Five brick banks and 4 gaps. Clear all the gaps and you're done.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_ACCU_01_DESCRIP: The loading bays are a prime place to deliver the goods. Work this spot to rack up some points.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: This is one industrial strength waterfront. Bang out all the requirements on the pier, at the loading docks, and drydocks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_GAP_01_DESCRIPT: And it's going really fast...^^Time to match speed and transfer from pipe to pipe.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_GAP_02_DESCRIPT: Someone left these pieces of iron just laying around. Conveniently awesome, huh?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_GAP_02_OBJ_03: Gap from scrap metal to bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_GAP_02_OBJ_04: Manual on and off the propeller
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_GAP_03_DESCRIPT: Time to drop in and fly.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_01_DESCRIP: Hmm a list of tricks to do and a sick place to do them. Get busy.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_01_OBJ_07: Grind the ledge in the corner
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_02_DESCRIP: Time to lay some sick brick tricks, sir.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_02_OBJ_02: Grind barrier, drop into the bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_02_OBJ_03: Do a slide on the spine
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_LIST_02_OBJ_10: Grind the back of the block
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_SIMUL_01_DESCRI: Who ordered a round of boat launches? We did.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_SURV_01_DESCRIP: It's ok to succumb to the Pier pressure just this once. Don't blow it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_TAG_01_DESCRIPT: How fast can you grind all the marked coping areas in the bowl?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_INDU_03_TAG_02_DESCRIPT: Come up with a line that will get you grinding all the marked ledges.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_ACCU_01_DESC: Grind it out. Grind it high. This bench on the bank is asking to be killed.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_DESC: This '09 classic is back, but with loads of activities to own. Some vert, some street. Mix it up and make it money.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_GAP_01_DESC: You're gonna have to hit this right to keep the speed and nail it, but if you do... money.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_GAP_02_DESC: The Maloof Bros. spent some coin to build a warm-up area that rips. So, rip it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_GAP_02_OBJ3: Hippy Jump the Rail into the Bank
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_GAP_03_DESC: Let's get nasty with this one. Hit the ramp to drop into the brick bank then gap the picnic table. Yeah, that should do it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_GAP_PUMP_HINT: Use <B:L_Trigger_hud> or <B:R_Trigger_hud> to Crouch^Pump those Transitionals!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_SIMUL_01_DESC: And, it's fun, too. Grind the bank and ignore that ledge.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_SIMUL_02_DESC: This one is for tweakers, so make sure you're tweaking when you clear the Mini-Mega gap.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_SURV_01_DESC: Keep alive and keep the points inside the half-pipe.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_TAG_01_DESC: Let loose from the noose and hit the six black spots along the course.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_TAG_02_DESC: Time to rip up the street course again, this time hitting the six red spots.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_MMCP_01_TRICK_01_DESC: Use the Mini-Mega and the half-pipe to knock out all the tricks on this Maloof Money Cup Trick List.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_ACCU_01_DESC: Trick for Points in the Chan Center Plaza
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_ACCU_02_DESC: Accumulate points by grinding the rails on this long stairset
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_DESC: The Chan Centre's a great place to brush up on your street skills. Shouldn't have too much trouble owning this lot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_GAP_01_DESC: Grind the rails to the lower level and don't touch those stairs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_GAP_02_DESC: Gap or Grind down this Stadium stairset to the Chan Center below.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_GAP_03_DESC: This bank is great to drop into. Gap the lip and drop into the bank with a sick grab.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_GAP_04_DESC: Ollie up and over the rail to the ramp below.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_SIMUL_01_DESC: Clear this steep stair set with a gap or grind to the Chan Center plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TAG_01_DESC: Grind 6 of the 12 Rainbow Rail benches around the Chan Center Plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TAG_02_DESC: Grind the 4 Planters around the Chan Center Monument
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TRICK_01_DESC: Knock out all the tricks on the list on either of these Chan Center ramps
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TRICK_01_OBJ0: Do any Fliptrick down the Ramp
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TRICK_01_OBJ2: Do a Grab Trick down the Ramp
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_01_TRICK_01_OBJ6: Trick Out of a Grind Down the Ramp
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_ACCU_01_DESC: Trick for points down this banked triple set in the Middle of the Campus.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_ACCU_02_DESC: Trick for points on and around the 4 curved planters in the Campus Entrance.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_DESC: The entrance isn't just a way to get to class on time. There are some killer spots in the ditch and around the bridge. Knock them out to own the lot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_GAP_01_DESC: Make the three gaps down this stairset. Gap to either side, then make it down the stairset with a sick grind.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_GAP_02_DESC: Gap the middle tier of the Campus Storage shed. Get some speed, pump the transition and make the transfer!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_GAP_03_DESC: There's a burly gap down into a bank. Hit it with a little spin to win!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_SIMUL_01_DESC: Grind your way down the massive kinked rail all the way to the bottom.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_SIMUL_02_DESC: Who grinds one story ledges!? Legends do! Now get up there and grind any of the ledges on top of the glass walls.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_SURV_01_DESC: Trick for points under the bridge without stopping, bailing or going offboard
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_TAG_01_DESC: Nothing fancy here, see how fast you can weave some tricks between each archway segment!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_TRICK_01_DESC: Knock out all the tricks around the Campus Bridge.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_02_TRICK_01_OBJ6: Grind the Top Edge of the Bowl
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_ACCU_01_DESC: Pump like mad and hope your feet don't stink because only tricks done with a foot or two off the board will count towards the target!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_ACCU_01_OBJ0: Only One or No-Foot Tricks Count
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_DESC: Suburbs... Carvatron... I mean, what else were we gonna call it? Own the suburban streets, pools and the Carvatron skatepark
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_GAP_01_DESC: Try this line straight out the front door. There's a couple extra median gaps along the way, keep your wheels off the grass if you want it to be legit.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_GAP_01_OBJ2: Gap the Grass to the Street
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_GAP_02_DESC: Gap across these three stair sets as you cruise down the sidewalk.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_GAP_03_DESC: Gap across the steps then land in a manual or grind. Maintain manny or grind past second arrow. Hit all six neighbor's stoops like this to complete.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_GAP_03_OBJ0: Manny or Grind Over Each Stoop
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_SIMUL_01_DESC: We pushed in a couple ramps for this shot. Let's see what you can do over this driveway hedge.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_SURV_01_DESC: You only need oneright? This pool might make you think twice.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TAG_01_DESC: Manual the course to the Community Parking Lot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TAG_02_DESC: Take a tour of the Community Skate Park and trick on all the rails and boobs.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TAG_03_DESC: We got some hurdleswe got a trackyou knew it was coming
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TRICK_01_DESC: Hit all the tricks on the list in this backyard pool.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TRICK_01_OBJ8: One-Foot Air Trick Off The Small Hip
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TRICK_02_DESC: Hit all the tricks in and around the Community Skate Park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_03_TRICK_02_OBJ3: Handplant the Top of the Corner
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_ACCU_01_DESC: Get ready to fly. It's air trick time in the bottom bowl at the Super Ultra Mega-park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_DESC: The Super Ultra Megapark has more than its share of killer lines and sick gaps. Take to the ramps and own it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_01_DESC: What's this tiny little street section of the mega park? An oasis of street in a desert of vert? Let's keep it streety for a minute.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_01_OBJ2: Gap from the Hump into Channel
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_01_OBJ3: Tweak a Handplant on the End Wall
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_02_DESC: Back and forth. See how fast you can hit these quarterpipes and gaps in this section of Super Ultra Mega gnar.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_02_OBJ3: Manual or Grind Across the Wood Ledge
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_GAP_03_DESC: Yeehaw! Yeah... maybe we'll just skip this description... Just make the gaps!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_SIMUL_01_DESC: When a problem comes along you must flip it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_SURV_01_DESC: Survive in the Hump Bowl of the park without stopping, bailing or going offboard.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_TAG_01_DESC: Tried and true, spin to win. Weave your way down the course and hit a 540 spin at every wall.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTL_UNIV_04_TRICK_01_DESC: Skate the mega ramps, make the gaps, beat the scores and rocket some air.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_01_DESC: High and low ledges to the left and right to choose from at this Spot Battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_02_DESC: Make sure to yell fore! before you hit up the signs at this Spot Battle. Wouldnt want you to land in the wrong hole or anything.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_03_DESC: Plenty of stairs to huck down but save the bangers for the ender set of stairs to count it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_04_DESC: The locals call this spot the Ninth Dimension. Not sure why, but it's fun to throw some tricks through the hole onto the sculpture below.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_05_DESC: Session battle out back behind the Brewery. Watch out for the smell and the empties.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_06_DESC: This landmark tree spot houses some foliage-friendly ledges and gaps.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_10_DESC: Rip it up at Rosalita in this session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_11_DESC: Figure eights for days in this session battle in the Kube Bowl
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_12_DESC: Take it to the air or hit up the hubba lines in this memorial session battle
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_13_DESC: Shred this pool under construction in this Hotel Sherwin session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_DWTN_14_DESC: Slappy sold his skateshop in San Van to open this car lot for you to skate in this session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_01_DESCRIPTION: Looks like a standard model AJ0063-B0013 mark IV transformer unit. Skate the crap out of it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: Looks like the quarry crew is taking a day off. Great chance to hit up the spot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: The artsy centerpiece to this parking lot makes for a sweet spot. Get creative if you want to get the high scores.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_04_DESCRIPTION: The giant spillway splitter is beyond epic. Get some speed and own it with huge grinds or blasty transfers up and over.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_05_DESCRIPTION: Time for some fun on this concrete playground. Own it with some manuals or grind the ledges until they're dust.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_06_OL_DESCRIPTION: Spot Battle at the Miracle Bowl. Watch out for those magic rails.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_07_DESCRIPTION: Session Spot at the infamous Haystings Park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_08_DESCRIPTION: Survive the drop-in and session the drydocks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_09_DESCRIPTION: Session battle for spot supremacy at the Bricklynn Banks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_10_DESCRIPTION: 2nd & Navy serves as the battle ground for this session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_INDU_11_DESCRIPTION: GiVeR your best in this spot battle at the GVR park.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_01_DESC: No one has any idea how this thing got alongside the highway... but that doesn't mean you can't own it!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_02_DESC: The drop might be epic, but it's all about how you land the bank at the other end.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_03_DESC: Take your speed from the bridge into this spot and score a killer trick over the drainage caps.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_04_DESC: This is one steep slope. Hit some of the tiered grind ledges with style to own this spot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_05_DESC: A cool stone wall down a long curving skate path. Hit the wall itself, the curving ledges or the stair at the end to mark this spot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_10_DESC: There are loads of lines for those willing to huck at this Super Ultra Mega session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_11_DESC: A slide, ladders, and large transfers. Go nuts at this neighbors pool session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_12_DESC: Everybody has a big buttpoolto session battle in.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_13_DESC: Flow, blast, or grind during this session battle at the Carvatron skatepark.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_OTS_UNIV_14_DESC: Smoking hot speed burner here at this ditch session battle.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_01_DESCRIPTION: Now it's your turn on the billboards. Get a photo of of yourself and Reda will get it put up.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_02_DESCRIPTION: It's time for you to shoot your own ad. Remember, shoot it anywhere you want!

language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_22_DESCRIPTION: It's time to shoot an ad with {1:TEAMMATE}. It's your ad campaign to rep your team, so shoot it anywhere you want!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_31_DESCRIPTION: Billboard time! Get a photo of {2:TEAMMATE} and Reda will get it put up.

language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_41_DESCRIPTION: Billboard time! Get a photo of {3:TEAMMATE} and Reda will get it put up.

language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYW_DESCRIPTION: Get some promotional material for your teammate. Find a good spot, do work, and make a snappy photo!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_ANYWHERE_INSTRUCTION3: You are too far away from the camera
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_01_DESC: This one is a raw street burner a huge flat gap that requires loads of speed and maximum pop.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_01_OBJ_2: Do a 360 Grab Over the Gap
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_02_DESC: Use the ramp and grind the top of the parking sign.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_02_HINT: Grind the sign from end to end!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_03_DESC: This is probably a water gap, but you can't be too sure with the Brewery so close by. Get some speed through the bridge and crack a big one.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_04_DESC: Port Carverton seems to have water gaps a plenty, and this waterfall one is plenty big.^^  Make sure you spot your landing carefully.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_05_DESC: This hefty hip transfer takes plenty of speed, pumping and the perfect line. Cards would love it. How about you?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_05_HINT: Carve and Pump those Transitionals!^<B:R_Trigger_hud> or <B:L_Trigger_hud>
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_06_DESC: Grind the sign and then gap over the bushes to land it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_06_OBJ_1: Grind the Sign and Gap the Bush
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_DWTN_07_DESC: Gap the flower bed to trick on the store awning
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_FIRST_DESCRIPTION: Photographers are the key to getting in magazines. Their challenges are about capturing a sequence from just the right angle. They'll tell ya' what to do, so get busy doing it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_01_DESCRIPTION: Heavy machinery rules. Heavy grinds on heavy machinery rules even more. Grind the bulldozer.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: San Vanelona had some burly drops, but they don't touch this one. Huck the drop and survive the lengthy gap in the tunnel.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_02_KILLED: 360 One Foot Air thru the tunnel
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: They call this the Easy Spot, but it's anything but. A quick flick is necessary to gap between these loading bay blocks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_03_OWNED_01: Gap or grind between the blocks
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_04_DESCRIPTION: Burnett found this sick little spillway kicker that would make an awesome photo for Thrasher. Do it justice.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_05_DESCRIPTION: Burnett spotted this and figured it was time to get over the top. The gap is pretty huge and the only easy way to shorten it is to grind out the ledge and then make the gap.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_05_KILLED_01: Slide the ledge to make the gap
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_05_OWNED_01: Grind the ledge to make the gap
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_INDU_06_DESCRIPTION: Nothing like a little vehicular drama to spice up a shot. Clear this hefty street gap for the cover.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_01_DESCRIPTION: Atiba is looking for a photo over the hipsomething big or something grindywhatevs is fine, just make sure you clear the hip.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_01_OWN_OBJ: Air or grind over the hip.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_02_DESC: Grind the PCU sign and help Atiba get a slick shot for The Mag.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_03_DESC: Air, carve, grind. Whatever you gotta do to clear this gap is fine... and don't worry, we have the ambulance on speed dial!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_03_OBJ2: Try and land the trick higher up!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_04_DESC: Thrasher is offering up a redemption cover shot. Nice of them, huh?^Gap down to the pillar and jump the shark!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_05_DESC: Landing into banks is always fun. Trick into this one to earn some coverage in Thrasher.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_06_DESC: This is nuts, but you ARE the Legend, right? Grind the outside of the bridge, and gap down to the support.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_06_OBJ0: Grind and Gap to Bridge Support
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_07_DESC: Corpsey is trying to get a trick on the roof. How about showing him how to do his "stupid" trick?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_08_DESCRIPTION: Time to get a photo of you and a trick... any trick. Use the banked ledge.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_PHOTO_UNIV_09_DESCRIPTION: There is more than one way to skate these banked ledges. See if you can gap the top of this one.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_DWTN_01_DESC: Race Dennis Busenitz through the Downtown Promenades
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_DWTN_03_DESC: This one's a scenic tour - meaning it's a long and windy race through all of downtown.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_INDU_01_DESCRIPTION: Deathracing through the Quarry is for the insane. Are you nuts enough to roll it?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: Speed burn the industrial spillway to take this race. Watch for places to get speed because they are there for the willing.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: Start in the spillway, make the transfer over to the rooftops, and finish up down by the water.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_OFFPATH: Fell of the path,^resetting on path
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_01_DESC: Skating to school is cool, but skating away from school hella fast rules. The race to the skatepark is on!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_02_DESC: Seriously... wear pads and a helmet. This one is soooo fast. See if you can beat the Deluxe skaters to the bottom.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_02_DESC_ONLINE: Seriously... wear pads and a helmet. This one is soooo fast.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_03_DESC: The skate path's got some sick spots, but it is also blazing fast... you'll need some pop to finish this one ahead of the Girl skaters.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_03_DESC_ONLINE: The skate path's got some sick spots, but it is also blazing fast... you'll need some pop to finish this one.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RACE_UNIV_04_DESC: Claim your crown, race to win down this epic mountain course.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RETRY_QUESTION: Are you sure you want to retry? Your challenge progress will be lost.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_RUN_END: Reach the end of the run for your score to count.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SIGNUP_RESUME_CAREER_CONFIR: Are you sure that you want to sign up and resume career?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_DWTN_02_DESC: A game of SKATE in the Park 'n Play parkade.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_DWTN_03_DESC: A game of SKATE through the bridge frame in the Core Plaza
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_DWTN_04_DESC: A game of SKATE down by the water in the Canal Plaza.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_FIRST_DESCRIPTION: Time to play a game of S.K.A.T.E.!^^S.K.A.T.E. is just like HORSE in basketball - one person sets a trick, and the other must match it. ^^Flip tricks and spins only - grabs and grinds don't count! Repeat a trick, lose your turn!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_INDU_01_DESC: Gap from one roof to the other. But here's the catch... There is a rooftop exit that needs to be tricked over in order to count your tricks.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_INDU_02_DESC: Time for a nice game of SKATE on the pier. Tricks count off the bench.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: A game of SKATE in the Spillway - flatground style.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_UNIV_01_DESC: A game of SKATE at the base of the Clocktower
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_UNIV_02_DESC: A game of SKATE at the Campus Entrance
language.ID_CHALLENGE_SKATE_UNIV_03_DESC: A game of SKATE over a simple stair set at the Peterson Pavilion

language.ID_CHALLENGE_SURVIVAL_GENERALOBJECTIVE: Work together to survive and reach the Goal
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_01_DESCRIPTION: Time to learn about getting around on your skateboard.^^Skate down the course and get used to riding your skateboard.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_02_DESCRIPTION: "Jumping" your skateboard is called an Ollie.^^Set up your ollie in the blue area, and Flick-It inside the yellow area to time your ollies correctly.^^<B:Stick_Right_Down> to Set Up^^Then <B:Stick_Right_Up> to Flick-It
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_03_DESCRIPTION: Grinding is easy with practice.^^Line yourself up with a rail or ledge, and then set up your ollie so you land into a grind.^^<B:Stick_Right_Down> to Set up, then <B:Stick_Right_Up> to Flick-It^^Use the path indicators to line up the rails and ledges on this course.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_03_OBJ_20_HINT_0: Complete at least 3 grinds to complete this tutorial
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_03: Move the left stick slightly to fine tune your approach
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_04: Move the left stick farther to turn faster
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_10: Follow the line indicators and ollie onto the rails
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_13: The longer you anticipate, ^the higher the ollie
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_14: The quicker you flick, ^the higher the ollie
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_16: Hop up over the stair set
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_19: Grinds happen automatically^just by landing on the rail
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_21: Use the ramp to hit the high rail
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SCHOOL_HINT_22: Grind the ledge to get down the stairs
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_01_DESC: Help finish the skate park so you can start shredding! We just got the last couple of ramps and a rail to finish the fun-box, all you need to do is move them into place and show us your style.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_01_TIP_CAMERA_CONT: <B:Stick_Left_hud> Pan camera^^<B:Stick_Right_hud> Rotate camera^^<B:DPad_UpDown_hud> Elevate camera^^<B:DPad_Arrows_hud> Zoom camera
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_02_DESC: The guys we hired to build this park just took off and left us with this. Help us get this thing upright so we can finish the half-pipe and start pulling some mad tricks!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_02_OBJ_04: Do a 360 spin in the half-pipe
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_02_TIP_OBJECT_CONT: <B:R_Trigger_hud> + <B:Stick_Left_L_R_hud> Rotate object^^<B:DPad_UpDown_hud> Elevate object^^<B:Stick_Left_hud> Move object^
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_02_VISUAL_CUSTOMIZ: Enter the quick menu and select Visual Customization
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_03_DESCRIPTION: So they built us a hubba like we asked... Problem is you gotta be superman to reach it. Help us build a smaller ledge right beside it so you can show us your skills.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_03_TIP_OBJECT_CONT: <B:R_Trigger_hud> + <B:Stick_Left_L_R_hud> Rotate object^^<B:DPad_UpDown_hud> Elevate object^^<B:Stick_Left_hud> Move object^
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_04_DESCRIPTION: We got this awesome catwalk, but we don't got a staircase to reach it. You've been pretty handy so far, and it looks kinda dangerous up there. Think you can fix it up and make this thing look good?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_04_OBJ_2: Change the color of both staircases
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_05_DESCRIPTION: Nice job with the construction, man! Now it's time to leave your own mark on this park! Put up a logo and throw together something here to show us what you got.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_05_OBJ_1: Get your logo up on the wall
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_UNIV_01_DESC: Moving dumpsters is one thing, but now it's time to build your own skate park. Lay down your first ramp to hit those rails and build your first fun-box.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKPK_UNIV_01_OBJ_03: Place a ramp close to the pad
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_01_101_DESCRIPTION: You made it! Now you know how to get around and ride a skateboard.^^Note:^You can replay the tutorials from the Challenge Map.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_101_DESCRIPTION: Nice work! Now you should have your ollie timing on lock!^^Remember:^You have to set up if you want a tight flick.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_FAILED: Complete at least 3 gaps to complete this tutorial
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_HINT_01: Prepare your Ollie^Pull <B:Stick_Right> back until you crouch
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_HINT_03: Pull <B:Stick_Right> back until you crouch^Then Flick-It forward quickly
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_HINT_04: <B:Stick_Right_Down> Set up in the Blue^<B:Stick_Right_Up> Flick-It in the Yellow
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_02_HINT_06: Get speed and approach the gap
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_03_101_DESCRIPTION: Sick! Nothing feels better than barking out some loud and long grinds.^^Prepare your grinds by setting up early.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_03_HINT_40: Do a fliptrick to exit grinds with a trick
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_04_101_DESCRIPTION: It can't be stressed how important it is to set your session marker!^^First, use <B:L_Bumper> + <B:DPad_Down> to Set a Marker^^Then use <B:L_Bumper> + <B:DPad_Up> to Go To a Marker
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_04_DESCRIPTION: Session Markers allow you to quickly retry your lines, without having to skate back to the start point.^^Get familiar with setting and going to Session Markers, and hit this ramp multiple times.^^Use <B:L_Bumper> + <B:DPad_Down> to Set a Marker^^Then use <B:L_Bumper> + <B:DPad_Up> to Go To a Marker
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_101_DESCRIPTION: OK, now you know how to adjust your grinds and mix it up.^^Remember:^Mix up your grinds for the best results.^If you're feelin it, you can also grab your board while grinding.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_DESCRIPTION: It's time to learn about advanced grinds.^^Adjust your board in the air to influence the type of grind that you will achieve.^^<B:Stick_Right> to adjust your board in the air
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_HINT_06: Turn your board to the side
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_HINT_08: Shift your board forward^^and turn your board to the left
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_HINT_09: Shift your board backward^^and turn your board to the right
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_HINT_10: Shift your board forward and right
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_05_HINT_11: Shift your board backward and left
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_06_101_DESCRIPTION: See? Flipping wood is pretty easy. And the tricks look sick.^^Every fliptrick is done by rotating and/or flipping your board in different directions.^^Flick the stick and see what you get.^^If you want to fine-tune your Flick-It skills, turn on the Trick Analyzer in the Pause Menu.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_06_DESCRIPTION: It is time to teach you the concept of flipping your board.^^<B:Stick_Right_hud> is the key to Flick-It.^^Copy the on-screen trick patterns to perform the desired fliptricks.^^You'll be rotating and flipping your board in every direction in no time.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_06_HINT_01: Every trick has a Nollie version^^Simply reverse the Flick-It gesture
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_06_OBJ_05: Nollie Shuvit^reverse ollie and rotate the board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_06_OBJ_18: Do a Nollie Frontside Pop Shuvit
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_101_DESCRIPTION: Yeah, sky pilot! There is so much you can do while blasting big gaps.^^Try different combos and see what you can do.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_DESCRIPTION: Learn a multitude of sick tricks to style our your airs.^^- Frontside Grabs^- Backside Grabs^- One Foot Airs^- Lateflips^- Fingerflips
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_HINT_01: <B:X_hud> or <B:~A_hud> to skate down the ramp
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_HINT_04: Do a 540^Spin faster with <B:Stick_Left_L_R> + <B:Stick_Right_L_R> held in same direction
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_HINT_08: Release your grab to land safely
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_OBJ_10: Point your nose forward^and then grab your board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_OBJ_13: Shift your tail down^and then grab your board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_07_OBJ_18: Turn your board sideways^and then grab your board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_101_DESCRIPTION: Nice! You found the sweet spot and you found your balance!^^Manuals are a slick way to extend your sequences and score big points.^^If you want assistance finding the sweet spot, turn on the Manual Meter from the Pause Menu.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_DESCRIPTION: A manual is when a skater rides on only two wheels.^^Riding on the back wheels is called a manual, and riding on the two front wheels is a nose manual.^^<B:Stick_Right> to Manual, find the sweet spot.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_04: Get into Manual^and do a Flip Trick
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_05: Do a Flip Trick^and land in Manual
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_07: Pull the right stick back slightly to do a manual
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_08: Push the right stick forward slightly to do a nose manual
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_09: Find the sweet spot while in air
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_10: Hold it in the sweet spot to land in manual
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_11: You pulled back too far. Release and try again.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_HINT_12: You pushed forward too far. Release and try again.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_08_OBJ_04: Do a trick and land into Manual
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_09_101_DESCRIPTION: Who would have thought you would learn to skate, before you learn to walk? We did! Sometimes it feels good to stretch your legs and feel the earth beneath your feet.^^Usually its way better to skate it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_09_DESCRIPTION: Sometimes a skater needs to get off the board to get around on foot. Skateboards can't go everywhere, you know. And these skills might help you reach some of those hidden spots.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_09_HINT_01: Press <B:Y> to get off the board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_09_HINT_02: Press <B:Y> to get on the board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_101_DESCRIPTION: You pumped on pumping?! You should be because it is the key to getting speed and boosting big airs.^^Remember:^Just stand up as you skate through transition.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_DESCRIPTION: Pumping is the art of using curved surfaces to gain speed or boost huge airs.^^Crouch in the blue area, and stand-up when you reach the yellow area.^^You can pump through any surface transition.^^Hold <B:L_Trigger> or <B:R_Trigger> to Crouch^^Release <B:L_Trigger> or <B:R_Trigger> to Stand Up
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_HINT_03: Ok, now pump anywhere through this course
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_HINT_04: Crouch in the blue^^Stand up in the yellow
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_HINT_07: Try a few more pumps^Crouch in the blue^Stand up in the yellow
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_10_HINT_08: Follow the line and pump the objects
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_101_DESCRIPTION: Way to work the dark side - of your board! Bust 'em out to impress the impressionable.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_3_HINT_10: You're on your own^Darkslide any of the rails
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_DESCRIPTION: Darkslides are done by flipping the board over, catching it with your feet while it's upside down and landing on a rail or ledge.^^Hold <B:R_Bumper> to Catch the Board while doing a Fliptrick.^^Remember, you need to fliptrick out of the darkslide to land it.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_HINT_01: Hold <B:R_Bumper> and then do a kickflip
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_HINT_02: Make sure to land on a rail
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_HINT_03: Flip out of the Darkslide to avoid bailing
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_HINT_N_01: Flip out of your Darkslide to land safely
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_11_HINT_N_02: Hold <B:R_Bumper> and then do a kickflip^Make sure to land on a rail!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_101_DESCRIPTION: Nicely done! There are all sorts of ways to underflip. Try to underflip a pop-shuvit!^^Remember:^Flip the board in the opposite direction, smoothly and quickly.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_DESCRIPTION: To do an Underflip, flip the board with your feet and then immediately flip the board in the opposite direction to underflip it.^^In one motion, Flick-It as if you were doing a kickflip or heelflip and quickly Flick-It back.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_HINT_01: Flick-it in the reverse direction Quickly!
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_HINT_02: Do both gestures, in one fluid motion
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_HINT_03: Do a kick or heelflip and quickly Flick-It back to underflip
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_12_HINT_04: Underflips are not possible from an ollie. Start with a kickflip or heelflip.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_ALL_COMPLETE__DESC: You finished the last tutorial in «School! You can stay and practice or you can get out there and start selling boards.^^Remember:^Check out the Trick Guide for all of the tricks.^^Would you like to continue your career?
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_SKSC_ONBOARD_TIP: Press <B:Y_hud> to get on your board
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_UNIV_01_DESCRIPTION: Setting up objects can add a little drama to your coverage. See if you can find a dumpster to move between these ramps, and then air over the dumpster.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_TUT_UNIV_02_DESCRIPTION: Instead of moving objects around, how about dropping objects in the world. Use the Object Dropper to drop a ramp in to help you get up on the cat walk.

language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_INDU_01_DESCRIPTION: Round 1: Jam in the drydock^Round 2: Jam in the boat
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_INDU_02_DESCRIPTION: Round 1: Best Trick on the rails or gap^Round 2: Best Trick in the whole bowl^Round 3: Jam in the whole bowl
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_INDU_03_DESCRIPTION: Round 1: Biggest Air^Round 2: Best Trick in the Bowl^Round 3: Jam in the Bowl
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_MMCP_01_DESCRIPTION: Round 1:  Mega Rail Jam.^Round 2:  Free-For-All Half Pipe.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_SKP5_01_DESCRIPTION: Round 1:  Mega Ramps^Round 2:  Mega Vert^Round 3:  Mega Street
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_UNIV_01_DESCRIPTION: Round 1:  Warm up on the course.^Round 2:  Free-For-All, jam style.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_UNIV_02_DESC: Round 1:  Jam in the elbow.^Round 2:  Grabs in the double bowls.^Round 3:  Jam in the spine bowl.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_UNIV_02_DESC_ONLINE: Round 1:  Jam in the elbow.^Round 2:  Grabs in the double bowls.^Round 3:  Jam in the spine bowl.
language.ID_CHALLENGE_VERT_UNIV_03_DESC: Round 1: Jam - Grabs-only.^Round 2: Best Trick - Anything goes.^Round 3: Jam - Anything goes.

language.ID_CREATEASPOTEDITOR_HELP_EDIT_DESCRIPTI: Now that you have found a nice area or set up some moveable objects it's time to designate your spot. Simply move, rotate, and scale the spot volume box to define your scoring area. Your spot can be anywhere, but remember, only tricks that touch the box will count.^^Any moveable objects you have positioned near your spot will be saved along with it and if you choose to upload your spot others will be able to skate your unique set up.  ^
language.ID_CREATEASPOTEDITOR_HELP_SCORE_DESCRIPT: After you are finished editing your spot, use the Session Marker to set the Spawn Point for your spot. The Spawn Point is where you and other skaters will start when playing your spot. Once you have set a good Spawn Point, land a trick that uses the spot.  ^^When you think you have pulled off the highest scoring trick possible, upload your spot to share it with the world! Anyone can download your spot and try to own it. The more that others play your spot, the longer it will stay online for other skaters to download so tell your friends to play it.^^Can you create the sickest spot in San Vanelona?

language.ID_DEMO_SPLASH_MASSIVE_CREDITS: This game incorporates dynamic advertisement serving technology offered by Massive Inc. which enables advertising to be temporarily uploaded into the game on your PC or console, and replaced while you play online. Massive only logs information that is needed to measure presentation of, and serve advertising to the appropriate geographic region, and to the right location within the game. Logged data may include Internet Protocol Address or gamer tag, in game location, length of time an advertisement was visible, size of the advertisements, and angle of view.
language.ID_DEMO_SPLASH_MASSIVE_CREDITS2: This information may be used to calculate the number of unique and repeat views of dynamic in game advertising. The logged information is not used to personally identify you. This ad serving technology is integrated into the game; if you do not want to use this technology, do not play the game while connected to the Internet. For more information see EA's privacy policy at privacy.ea.com or visit http://www.massiveincorporated.com/
language.ID_DEMO_SPLASH_MASSIVE_LEGAL: INCLUDES SOFTWARE THAT COLLECTS DATA NECESSARY TO PROVIDE ONLINE IN-GAME ADVERTISING.

language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_1: You have to use "Start Challenge" from the Pause menu to get things rolling when playing Career or Unranked challenges online.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_10: If you are a host of an online session, you can use the Host Actions menu to make your online session private or to disable challenge proposals.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_11: If you're feeling anti-social, you can adjust your «Feed options from the Game Settings menu.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_12: You can use the Feature option to give your top footage, photo or park "Featured" status in your Online «Profile.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_13: If you want to give your team a cool logo, you can make one at skate.ea.com, or use any of the cool shared logos created by the Skate community.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_14: You can upload your magazine footy straight to «Reel with the Career Photos Tab.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_15: You can keep in touch with teammates by posting messages to your Online Team Profile.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_16: If you are a Team Manager, be sure to select your best team footage, photos, and parks to feature on your Online Team Profile.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_17: Choose between Interactive and Playlist Mode by selecting a tab in the Music Player. To skip to the next song in-game, use:^^<B:L_Bumper_hud> + <B:DPad_Right>
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_18: «Profile is home to all your stats. You can find them for both Career and Multiplayer.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_19: You can change your Single Player Team logo and name anytime in the Edit Skaters screen.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_2: If you're feeling bored at work or school, visit skate.ea.com to check out the latest Skate news, and keep up to date with Skates online community.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_20: You can use the Object Dropper anywhere when youre not in a challenge, but you can only drop «Park terrain in «Park areas.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_21: You can change the overall difficulty in the Pause Menu by selecting Options, Game Settings, and Difficulty.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_22: If you're trying to get a trick on lock but you cant figure out what you are doing wrong, turn on the Trick Analyzer in the Pause Menu under Learn and On Screen Help.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_23: Once you make friends online their characters start appearing as Port Carverton locals. Keep an eye peeled for skaters with names over their heads.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_24: You cant solve problems with violence but you can start problems by holding <B:R_Bumper_hud> when you are close to pedestrians.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_25: The Session Marker resets your line timer. Remember this when you're trying to rack up points in Contests or Accumulation challenges.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_26: Speed can be your friend if you're going big, but it can also make it harder to time your ollies or land your tricks.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_27: Switch is when you're riding in the opposite stance of what's normal for you. Remember, grabs and flick-it controls get reversed in switch. You'll get it if you pay attention to your stance.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_28: Backside grinds are performed when you approach the rail with your butt pointing towards it. You can figure out the rest for frontside grinds.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_29: The Object Dropper has a lot of uses. Try selecting a moveable object you find and use the dropper to move or even delete it.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_3: You can check out «Feed to keep up to date with your friends, teammates and the latest Skate 3 news.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_30: Doing tricks gets your line going. It shows up in the lower left corner of the screen. Keep that line alive by doing different tricks and you will get a multiplier. It maxes out at times 3 and ends when you bail, repeat too many tricks, or run out of steam.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_31: Less than 4 wheels on the ground starts a sequence while 4 down ends it. Landing to manual is a great way to keep your sequence alive when scores count.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_4: You can take your Career challenges online using the Career tab in the Online Challenge Map.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_5: You need to set up a Team Lobby before you can take on other online teams in Ranked Team events.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_6: Unranked Team events will randomly team you up with other skaters, no need to be formalor good, maybe you'll get someone who rips on your team.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_7: You earn extra board sales any time your uploaded footage, photos, or parks get viewed and rated by the Skate community.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_8: The Contacts menu can be used to check out what your online friends and teammates are up to.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_9: You can use the Online Team menu to find an online team, or just keep tabs on your current online team.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_DEMO_1: Better hurry soon or youll miss out on your chance to skate like a pro with the Black Box Distribution Skate Park.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_DEMO_2: Be sure to check out the all-new website. Your one-stop shop for all the latest Skate 3 news & info.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_DEMO_3: Become a fan on Facebook @ FACEBOOK.COM/SKATE or follow us on Twitter @ TWITTER.COM/HIPPYJUMP.
language.ID_HINTS_TEXT_DEMO_4: Skate 3 will be in stores in North America on May 11, 2010 and worldwide on May 14, 2010.  Start counting down the days!

language.ID_LOADING_TIP_01_DESC: Downtown San Van has lots of big rails and spots to session, but watch out for the heat. Security is usually on the prowl.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_02_DESC: The Suburbs are full of alley shortcuts and backyard pools. Hidden spots reward the adventurous.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_03_DESC: Winding streets and crazy traffic can make Old Town pretty hectic. Hit up the many plazas if you need a break from the gnarliness.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_04_DESC: With the steepest, fastest streets in San Vanelona, The Res gives speed freaks what they're looking for.  Bomb the hills, hit the curb cuts and find the wallrides.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_05_DESC: Timing is the key to getting into grinds and clearing gaps. Get crouched before popping big ollies to get up onto and over things.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_06_DESC: Place a custom Session Marker to quickly retry a difficult spot.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_07_DESC: While turning, swing the left stick downwards to get into a Powerslide. Use Powerslides to check your speed and slide through tough corners.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_08_DESC: Gently push the right stick up or down to find the Manual balance point.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_09_DESC: Too many friends fighting for their turn? Try out Party Play and compete head to head with up to 3 friends.
language.ID_LOADING_TIP_10_DESC: Without the footage it's fiction. Upload your photos and footage to «Reel so the world can check out your wicked skating skills.
language.ID_MAP_FIRST_TIME_IN_ONLINEMAP: Welcome to the Online Challenge Map!^^This map is your gateway to all online gameplay. Use the tabs at the top to join or create team, career, freeskate or versus online sessions.^^You can return to the map at any time to jump into an online session, propose challenges, or move the location of your current session.^
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_ALL_VERT: Contests focusing on bowls, pools, half-pipes, and big air blasting Mega-Ramps.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_DEATHRACE: This one's pretty simple. First to the finish line wins. Just follow the gates to guide you there.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_FILM: Film challenges focus on getting footage of lines, because without the footy it's fiction.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_GETTINGSTARTED: These are the first few challenges to get your feet wet in your Skate 3 career.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_HOM: Wreck yourself as hard as you can in these masochistic challenges.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_OTL: So many activities! Try to complete as many of them as you can to own all the lots!
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_OTS: These are all the spots you've found. Beat the best sequence score to own 'em!
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_PHOTO: Shoot photos with pro photographers as you try to get the best sequences possible.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_PRO: Skate with pros to see about getting hooked up with a shoe sponsor.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_PROMOTIONAL: Promote your brand by shooting photos and films featuring you and your team.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_STREET: Contests focusing on rails, ledges, stairsets and the more technical side of skating.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_CHALLENGE_TRAINING: Get schooled by Coach Frank, or just session his super fun training grounds.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_BLACKBOXPARK: Visit the home skatepark for the Zero, Mystery and Fallen skate teams.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_DOWNTOWN: Tons of street spots with a wide range of rails, ledges, and plazas to skate.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_INDUSTRIAL: A great place to keep it raw in this slightly more challenging - and rusty - district.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_MALOOF: A healthy mix of traditional half-pipe and Mini-Mega madness brought to you by the Maloof Brothers.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_SKATE_PARKS: Check out some skateparks that you can fully tweak and customize.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_SKATE_SCHOOL: Hit the super fun training grounds of Coach Frank's «School.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_LOCATION_UNIVERSITY: Port Carverton's finest Institution of Higher learning! Plazas, rails, backyard pools, and Megapark gnarliness.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_COMP_1UP: Get the best total score and don't spell 1-UP.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_COMP_DOMINATION: Whoever owns the most spots in each area wins!
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_COMP_SKATE: Take turns doing each others' best tricks or get a letter. Spell SKATE and you lose.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_COMP_SPOTBATTLE: Whoever gets the highest scoring trick owns the spot!
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_FREESKATE_DOWNTOWN: Tons of street spots with a wide range of rails, ledges, and plazas to skate.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_FREESKATE_INDUSTRIAL: A great place to keep it raw in this slightly more challenging - and rusty - district.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_OL_FREESKATE_UNIVERSITY: Port Carverton's finest Institution of Higher learning offers plazas, rails, backyard pools, and Mega-park gnarliness.
language.ID_MAP_HELPER_SP_TEAM: All the challenges below that involve your teammates are summed up here.
language.ID_MAP_LEADERBOARD_NO_DATA: No friend leaderboard entries for this challenge.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DLC_BLACKBOXPARK: Home of the Zero, Mystery, Slave, and Fallen teams, this park has a solid mix of street and tranny  perfect for getting tricks dialed before taking it to the streets to film.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_ALETOWN: The brewery is at the heart of this Port Carverton neighborhood, but the bricks and rails are the soul.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_ALLMART: The open air mall where the signs were built to grind. Come for the shopping stay for the skating.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_CARVERTONMEMORIA: Epic park paying tribute to fallen soldiers of all sorts. Street meets huge tranny in this stone wonderland.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_CRYSTALTOWERS: Wavy benches and open plazas in the core of Downtown Port Carverton.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_HOTELDISTRICT: Keep it classy around Hotel Sherwin. Lots of street and a pool under construction if you can find it.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_KUBETOWER: A condo complex  for affluent skaters, the Kube Tower boasts some fun street and a sublime 8 bowl.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_MIDTOWNPROMENADE: A fun urban walkway where pedestrians and skaters rule.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_PARKNPLAY: A multi-level parking garage with lines and spots for days.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_PLAZAOFSOLITUDE: There are some big sets and surreal fountains to skate for those not afraid to get wet.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_RIPPONTOWERS: The architects went nuts with the concrete ribbons thing in this Downtown apartment complex.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_ROSALITASKATEPAR: Session this flowing snake run or take it upstairs for some grinds on ledges of the over-pass.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_SLAPPYSCARLOT: Slappy sold his skateshop in San Van and fulfilled his dream of owning a used car-lot. Slappy knows whats up.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_TRESOUTTAPLAZA: A plaza with some hefty rails and buttery ledges. The locals like to see flip outta grinds at this spot.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_DT_UPTOWNPROMENADE: The start of Port Carvertons scenic walkway. Lots of speed and some interesting spots hidden amongst the buildings if you venture from the main path.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_2NDANDNA: Scenic street spot under a harbor side pier.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_CARVERTO: This is where Port Carverton got its start. Industrial roadways carved into a mountain of rock make for some harrowing lines.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_DRYDOCKS: Empty ship hulls, massive transitions and some weathered street obstacles down by the ocean.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_FACTORYR: Take to the factory roofs to get into trouble. Look before you leap, or youll get worked.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_GHETTOSP: The locals put together a raw street DIY spot. Lots of open spaces to play with here.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_HAYSTING: A huge bowl and large street park are the highlights at Port Carvertons premiere skatepark.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_LOADINGD: Fun banked truck loading docks housed near the legendary Bricklynn Banks.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_MIRACLEB: Huge bowl located at the bottom of the Industrial Spillway. Be sure to hit the two mega rainbow rails.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_OLDFACTO: A mess of rusty and dilapidated factory buildings. Lots of banks with Jersey barriers and heavy machinery to grind.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_PIPEWORK: Factory fun with lots of pipes to grind and warehouses to get lost in.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_SPILLWAY: The start of a blistering fast spillway run through the Industrial district.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_INDUSTRIAL_TANKER: A huge ship with a conveniently empty hull to skate. Gotta love Port Carverton!
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_MALOOF_STREET: One of the best street courses in recent contest memory; complete with rails, A-frame ledges, stair sets,  gaps, and a healthy wall for acid drops.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_MALOOF_VERT: A healthy mix of traditional half-pipe and Mini-Mega madness brought to you by the Maloof Brothers.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_SKATEPARK_DOWNTOWN: Open air street-style area for the downtown shredders.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_SKATEPARK_STADIUM: The PCU Landsharks Mega-sized skatepark with mega-sized ramps to play with. Get ready to go big.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_SKATEPARK_TEAMHQ: Reda procured a training facility for your team to skate. Two levels and lots of space for you to skate and create.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_SKATEPARK_TRAINING: The home that the Coach Frank built, but you can change up however you like. A great place to get a hang of Skate park creating.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_SKATESCHOOL: Home of Port Carvertons resident instructor of skate-ology, Coach Frank. His Stereo sponsored "school grounds" are the best place to get tricks dialed without the hassles of traffic and pesky pedestrians. Drop by for a lesson, then stay for a session.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_CAMPUSENTRANCE: Banks with ledges, huge Hubbas, a couple curved monster set of stairs and a whole lot more going on at the entrance to the sickest skate university in the world.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_CARVATRON: A red beauty of a skatepark down at the bottom of the University District. A fun open bowl with some street stuff around the outside.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_CHANCENTER: Open plaza area with nice curved planters, unique benches and a variety of handrails to hit.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_CLOCKTOWER: Tons of small banks to ledges to get etch with at this PCU landmark.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_DALYESTATES: A residential area with some fun front yards to skate, but the backyard pools are where the juice is at.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_HARTLEYSTADIUM: Sporting home of the Fighting Landsharks. Plenty of open street spots mixed with some truly gnarly tranny. A perfect place to jump a shark.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_OBSERVATORY: Top of the hill starting point for the ditch, skate path, and University Road hill bombs with a bonus bowl to shred as well.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_PCULIBRARY: No way you can keep it quiet here with all the rails and planters to grind. Be sure to take it to the roof for some of the longest rails in Port Carverton.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_PETERSONPAVILI: Mellow but fun street plaza featuring a series of stair sets and rails. Great place to put some lines together.
language.ID_MAP_LOCATION_DESC_UNIV_SUPERULTRAMEGA: PCUs dedication to building winners is evident at this Danny Way inspired monstrosity of a Mega-fun-track.

language.ID_MISSION_OL_FA_SLAPPYS_03_SLAPPYS_ACCU: Score points on Slappy's unique set up of funboxes and rails.
Work together to score grind points using Slappy's supply rails, ledges, and even a hubba.
language.ID_MISSION_OL_FA_SLAPPYS_04_SLAPPYS_SURV: Work together to survive Slappy's Halfpipe and match the point requirement. If a skater bails, stops skating, goes offboard, or leaves the area then your points are reset.

language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_1UP_DESCRIPTION: The leader sets the best total score in the time limit. Each competitor must beat this score or get a letter. If you get the best score then you are the leader! Spell 1-UP and you lose!
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_BEST_TRICK_DESCRIPTI: Record the best trick on an obstacle within the allocated time. It's not just time, it's other skaters you have to beat.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_DEATH_RACE_DESCRIPTI: Race head to head against other skaters through a variety of different race courses. Keep your speed in check to survive to the finish, but don't run out of time along the way or you will be disqualified.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_FAVOUR_DESCRIPTION: Staying within a distance, follow the skater.   Make sure you don't lose sight of him for long.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_FILM_DESCRIPTION: Satisfy the listed goals in any order within the recording time. Start anywhere at anytime.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_FOLLOW_DESCRIPTION: Staying within a distance, follow the skater. Make sure you don't lose sight of him for long.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_HALLOFMEAT_DESCRIPTI: Take turns trying to achieve the nastiest wipeout. You can bail anywhere so get creative to come out on top!
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_JAM_DESCRIPTION: Outscore all opponents in the Jam contest before the timer expires.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_MEGARAMP_DESCRIPTION: Each skater takes turn to skate on Danny Way's MegaRamp. The skater with the best run, wins!
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_ONLINE_DEATH_RACE_DE: Race head to head against other skaters through a variety of different race courses. Keep your speed in check to survive to the finish, but don't run out of time along the way or you will be disqualified.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_ONLINE_FREEKSATE_ING: Share newly discovered spots, film sick lines with your crew, or just kick back and socialize.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_ONLINE_FREESKATE_DES: Tear it up in a private game session with Friends or join a public game session and make some new ones.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_ONLINE_SPOTBATTLE_DE: Take turns trying to perform the highest scoring trick on a spot. Watch out for "Session Spots" where you get to session for a point total.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_OWN_THE_SPOT_DESCRIP: Take turns trying to perform the highest scoring trick on a spot. Just don't bail or your turn is over!
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_PHOTO_DESCRIPTION: Perform a trick or trick sequence that meets the photographer's requirements.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_PRO_DESCRIPTION: The pro has expectations. Listen to them and beat them!
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_SKATE_DESCRIPTION: Avoid earning the letters S.K.A.T.E by copying Flip Tricks successfully. Give letters to others by setting difficult Flip Tricks to copy.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_SPOT_RACE_DESCRIPTIO: Race from spot to spot, complete all trick objectives, and cross the finish line in this online exclusive event.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_STREET_DESCRIPTION: Take it to the streets - contest style. Get to work on rails and ledges or throw down some tech flatground. The player or team to place the best across all rounds, wins.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_STREETSKATING_DESCRI: First run is timed and each skater uses the whole course. The rest of the rounds session an obstacle within the allowed time.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_TUTORIAL_DESCRIPTION: Think you know everything? Learn by watching and performing moves with these helpful sessions.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATE_VERT_DESCRIPTION: Tranny skating is all about getting big airs, long grinds, and blasting crazy gaps in areas with curved transitions. The player or team to place the best across all rounds, wins.
language.ID_MISSION_TEMPLATEUP_DESCRIPTION: The leader sets the score, then everyone takes turns trying to 1-Up the leader's score. If you do, you're the new leader. If you can't, you get a letter. Get 3 letters and you're out... last one standing wins!
